Standalone review site: open index.html straight from Finder or host the folder as-is. The units are embedded from the folders beside this file; each card links to the shippable index.html, the StackAdapt zip and the backup image under downloads/. The preview caps each ad at 2 loops and holds the final frame; shipping units keep their own cap. The timeline scrubs one 15 s loop, driving the ad's real animations and video.
